answer: Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-pulse staking: each identity must lock a bond and emit a periodic heartbeat signed with its key. Missed pulses burn a slice of the bond, and a fresh identity's ember is too dim to earn rewards until it burns for several epochs. Reputation acts as a lantern, letting peers see sustained history rather than a swarm of new accounts, so forging many identities costs real capital and time.
